user.description: Put the device in setup mode first: press and hold the Mode button for 2 seconds until the mode LED flashes.

reauth_confirm.description: {name} rejected the saved key. Put the device in setup mode (press and hold the Mode button for 2 seconds until the mode LED flashes), then select Submit. Afterwards, hold Mode for 2 seconds again to return to normal operation.
